description: This file defines a utility class 'SupportUtil' providing helper methods for text styling and hyperlink handling in Android TextView components, including methods to create bold and URL spans and to set styled text with clickable links based on resources.

classes.name: SupportUtil
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to create styled Spannable strings and assign them to TextView widgets, including methods to set bold text, URL links, and combining text with embedded URLs for Android applications.

methods.name: strong
methods.description: Creates a SpannableString with bold styling applied to the entire input CharSequence.

methods.name: url
methods.description: Creates a SpannableString that turns the entire input CharSequence into a clickable URL link targeting the specified URL string.

methods.name: setTextWithURL
methods.description: Overloaded method that sets styled text with an embedded URL into a TextView, either by resource IDs or by direct link label string, enabling clickable links within localized text.
